words: Partner-plan members used CASSI's provider network, but had no dedicated app and fragmented services.
Every service was redesigned for members whose coverage comes from another health plan.
Several accounts stay signed in on one device, so members switch between family or contract profiles without logging out.
A separate in-house app meant starting from zero, but gave CASSI the direct control over code that its vendor-built main app lacked.
A dedicated app for partner-plan members shipped on iOS and Android, with a documented component library.
extra: The challenge was to give this audience a clear way to manage their care.
